svg.title: Figure 1. Ranking of all cell types by classifier probability
svg.desc: Figure 1. Top: a barcode of all 11,751 cell types ranked by classifier probability. Green ticks for the 312 male-specific types and cyan ticks for the 166 dimorphic types crowd the left end. An enlarged top 10% shows that 116 of the 118 highest-scoring types are sex-related, and the top 10% holds 85% of all 478. Bottom: precision-recall curves with AUC-PR 0.759 for all 89 features, 0.726 static features only, 0.701 with hemilineage-grouped folds and 0.489 topology only, against chance at 0.041.
